notes: Re-anchored 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491): the verdict is unchanged and the behaviour is unchanged, but the two methods this row pointed at are gone. ExpandCurrency and CollapseCurrency were a SEARCH-BASED expand/collapse pair serving the currency string alone; they are replaced by Materialize (logical -> physical, positionally, by each symbol's own GR14 width) and by DeEdit's own physical cursor (physical -> logical, the same widths in reverse), which serve the currency string and the PICTURE EDITING literal through ONE mechanism. The search was also a latent composition hazard: with an editing literal expanded first, a '$' inside a literal could be found before the mask's own currency position. Verified green by unit:CobolEditCurrencyStringTests over the whole one- and multi-character currency-string matrix.
